title: Drag and dropping task to another virtual desktop inside pager sometimes briefly flickers back before moving
line: A window dropped onto another desktop in the Pager no longer flashes back on its old desktop before moving.
explanation: The Pager dragged the window outline itself, reparenting it out of its desktop. On release it hid the outline, asked KWin to move the window and immediately reset the whole model, which recreated the outline on its old desktop; until KWin's desktop change arrived (a frame or two) the outline showed there again. The change drags a separate stand-in rectangle and only hides the real outline meanwhile, so the model is never reset; after a drop the stand-in stays where it was dropped until the outline leaves its old desktop (or 1 s passes if the window doesn't move).

commits.message:
applets/pager: Drag a stand-in instead of the window outline itself

Dragging reparented the outline and every release reset the model, so a
dropped outline flashed back on its old desktop until KWin moved it.
Drag a separate rectangle that stays where it was dropped until then.

BUG: 524124

media.caption: Pager frames right after dropping the outline from desktop 3 onto desktop 1: in the 4th frame it is back on desktop 3 and desktop 1 is empty.
Same drop with the fix: the outline stays on desktop 1 in every frame.
10 drags between desktops 1 and 3: each drop onto desktop 1 flashes the outline back on desktop 3 (5 of 10 drops).
Same 10 drags with the fix: no flash.
